description: Scan statistics for one dynamic QR code: scans and unique visitors in a range (30 days by default), all-time scans, the last scan, the top countries, devices and operating systems, and scans per day. Use it when the person asks how a code is doing or how often it was scanned. Needs the person signed in to QRdx; how far back it goes depends on their plan.

id.description: The code's id, from create_dynamic_code or list_codes

range.description: How far back: 7d, 30d (default), 90d, 365d, 1095d or all, within what the plan keeps

name: get_code_stats
title: Get a code's scan stats
